hypothesis: The observed static branch lacks a direct RGB anchor; adding the released2024 observed-static photometric term can test this independently of dynamic background-opacity pressure.
math: L_S = L_paper_original + 1.0 * ((1-lambda_dssim)*L1((1-Md)*render_s,(1-Md)*GT) + lambda_dssim*(1-SSIM((1-Md)*render_s,(1-Md)*GT))); lambda_dssim remains original0.2, full-image reduction. render_s includes the shared environment.
paper_status: Extra diagnostic absent from displayed paper Eq10, not author-certified Eq13/Eq14 reconstruction or a claim that the paper omitted a mandatory static RGB loss.
initial_state: Identical original post-reset30000 four-state bundle; do not initialize from V32000.
coefficient_origin: Released2024 static photo term coefficient1; fixed before S, not tuned from S outcomes.
secondary_context: Previously completed V tests a different single added term. S-versus-V is descriptive comparison of two interventions, not attribution to only one changed variable between them.
primary_endpoints: Reuse exactly the existing c725cd locked long protocol11 primary metrics, all49 frame values and six original domains; preserve equal-frame and pixel-weighted labels. Interpret against both B1 and B2 and their observed repeat variation; the two repeats are not a CUDA noise bound or confidence interval.
supplementary_context: Actor pooled MSE/pixel counts plus the already-defined SSIM-window-derived5px interior/boundary localization are descriptive. They do not replace or erase any adverse all49 endpoint and do not change masks or optimization.

interpretation.static_improves_actor_preserved: Supports a missing observed-static RGB anchor as a recoverability mechanism without V's direct background-opacity pressure. Dynamic background support and temporal invariance still require their own evidence.
interpretation.static_improves_actor_cost_repeats: Shows the tradeoff survives a different added term; inspect static occlusion/depth order, shared environment and temporal coupling rather than attributing it only to V's background-opacity penalty.
interpretation.static_does_not_recover: Weakens this coefficient1 anchor as a recovery mechanism in the original degenerated30k state; does not reject the paper algorithm or an identically initialized from-zero experiment.

validity: Verify all original10 scalars from actual compose BEFORE computing or adding S and again before real first backward; check FP32 original+coefficient*S total decomposition.
Verify exact original30k saved parameters/optimizers/RNG/sampler/runtime restore and every2000 camera/time_shift/LR entry against actual B1; preserve extra-eval RNG.
Use original all49 GT, masks, counts, loader and camera transforms; no new data, shadow masks, depth policy or time policy.
Keep 50000 horizon and stop32000 before33000 reset; SGCM/densification are already inactive in this window.
Terminal49 evaluation and four independently loadable saved state files with original source/config/checkpoint pins protected.
claim_limit: A successful S recovery is not from-zero generalization, normal editing, complete branch identification, or reproduction of the author's unpublished2026 implementation.
acceptance_policy: No new numerical margins and no posthoc coefficient tuning. Report directional improvements and every composite/actor tradeoff against both original repeats; visual improvement or one scalar alone cannot certify the paper.
launch_gate: Independent final S source/config/guard/harness/plan review, root review of the read-only fixed-time scan, then root exact S receipt and component-only exclusive GPU handoff. This protocol itself authorizes no GPU run.
